files.prompt: Generate ONE image: a game texture sheet of EXACTLY three blank neon sign frames, stacked vertically as three rows, on a pure solid black background (#000000) filling the entire canvas edge to edge. Each frame is a wide horizontal rectangle about 4 times wider than tall, spanning almost the full width, with even black gaps between rows and nothing touching the canvas edges. Row 1: hot magenta-pink glass neon tube outline with rounded corners and a thin inner second tube. Row 2: electric cyan neon tube double border with small decorative corner hooks. Row 3: warm amber-orange neon tube border with a dotted chaser-light inner row of tiny bulbs. Inside each frame is EMPTY dark backing panel (very dark grey #0a0a10), the center must be blank so text can be added later in the game. Photorealistic glowing neon tubes with soft bloom halo, slight rain droplets on the backing, cyberpunk night mood. Front-on orthographic view, perfectly straight, no perspective. SIZE: exactly 1024 x 1024 pixels, a perfect SQUARE image. [+ standard tail: no text/letters/logos/watermark, use built-in image tool, save to ~gpt-generated-images]
files.notes: Two 3-frame sheets cropped and packed: column 0 = sheet 1 (prompt below), column 1 = sheet 2 (p02: lime bevel / UV purple + red inner / icy white-blue Thai arch). Black background = treat as emissive map (additive) or alphaTest by luminance. Glow halo baked; still add bloom.
